decisions.rationale: Allows users to analyze legacy projects while defaulting to modern stack (net10.0, net11.0)

summary: Phase 1 Complete: Configurable .NET Version Targeting. Implemented --target-frameworks CLI option in src/server/Program.cs. Supports net6.0-net11.0 with net10.0/net11.0 as defaults. Advertising via MCP instructions. Ready to start Phase 2 (Resources).

decisions.decision: Keep all frameworks in build matrix (net6.0-net11.0)
decisions.rationale: Allows library compatibility testing and framework migration analysis
LTS + latest; users opt-in to legacy via CLI flag

summary: Phase 2 Complete: Resources Implementation. Implemented IResourceProvider with 4 resource handlers (Types, Members, Metadata, References). All handlers use static methods, InvariantCulture, and follow code analysis rules (0 errors/warnings). Created integration tests. Resources enable context queries without calling tools. Ready for Phase 3 (Prompts).
